name: ASTEEL Group Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司未公告任何业务板块的产能扩张、新业务进入、业务缩减或出售，也未公布新的重大合约。年内主要事项为Hii Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd提出的无条件强制全面收购要约，以及董事会委员会成员变动。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长20.8%，净利润同比增长146.8%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce any capacity expansion, entry into new businesses, business reduction or divestment, nor any new major contracts. The main events during the year were the unconditional mandatory take-over offer by Hii Capital Holdings Sdn Bhd and changes in board committee memberships. Latest quarter (2026-09-30) revenue grew 20.8% year-on-year and net profit grew 146.8% year-on-year.
